description: This file defines the 'FailureMarker' class which manages failure marker files in a Drupal package management context, including creating, reading, and excluding the marker file during stage operations.

classes.name: FailureMarker
classes.description: Handles creation, retrieval, and exclusion of failure marker files within the Drupal package management system.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the failure marker file.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes failure information to the marker file, including stage, message, and optional throwable details.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves and parses data from the marker file, throws exception if decoding fails.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the failure message, optionally including backtrace details.

methods.name: assertNotExists
methods.description: Throws exception if the failure marker file exists.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to, specifically for excluding the marker file.

methods.name: excludeMarkerFile
methods.description: Adds the marker file path to the list of paths to exclude during stage operations.
